test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programs launched by the Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh in August 2021 is called by him as 'a reflection of the government's resolve to create a self-reliant defence sector'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DISC 5.0.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **DISC 5.0** is a reflection of the Government’s resolve to create a** self-reliant defence sector**.
 
• The challenge is to take innovation, design & development to newer heights.
 
• iDEX plays a crucial role in building a strong military & ‘AatmaNirbhar’ defence industry.
 
• Government support to the private sector in building ‘**AatmaNirbhar Bharat**.'

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​DISC's **full form is** Defence India Startup Challenge.**
 
• The Ministry of Defence is chaired by **Shri.** **Rajnath Singh**.
 
• Stating that DISC 5.0 is a reflection of the Government’s resolve of creating an ‘AatmaNirbhar’ defence sector, he exuded confidence that this challenge will move forward from its earlier editions and take innovation, design & development to newer heights.
